item.text:
**3B.4 Research Note**

Net assessment: **mostly negative**. I found formal due-process guarantees and one rare torture trial, but no credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan built a robust system for civilian oversight, complaint handling, or independent investigation of abuse by protected actors. The record instead shows **persistent impunity** and **ineffective complaint channels**.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says torture and ill-treatment in police/gendarmerie custody and prisons have rarely been rigorously investigated since 2016 and perpetrators even more rarely prosecuted. It also cites beatings after the February earthquakes and a death in gendarmerie custody. | 3B.4; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Submission by Human Rights Watch on Türkiye to the Human Rights Committee](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-23 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee | HRW found little evidence of effective investigations into enforced disappearances. It says many families had to file repeated complaints just to get detention acknowledged, and some victims may have been pressured not to complain. | 3B.4; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [2024 special report on testimonies, interviews, informant-making, and abductions through coercion and threats](https://ihd.org.tr/en/2024-special-report-on-testimonies-interviews-informant-making-and-abductions-through-coercion-and-threats/) | Human Rights Association (İHD) | 2024-11-22 | https://ihd.org.tr/en/2024-special-report-on-testimonies-interviews-informant-making-and-abductions-through-coercion-and-threats/ | İHD says complaints to the Law Enforcement Surveillance Commission since 2019 were not even taken into consideration, and no suspected officers were investigated. That points to a formally existing but ineffective complaint mechanism. | 3B.4; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says due process remains severely compromised, courts often ignore higher-court rulings, and prosecutors do not consistently investigate torture or abuse in custody. It also notes resistance to publishing the CPT detention report. | 3B.4; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Mixed, weak positive | [UN Body to Examine Türkiye’s Record on Torture](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0 | HRW notes a rare exception: after years of delay, three police officers and a doctor were finally set to face trial in the Eyüp Birinci torture case. This is real accountability, but it is isolated rather than systemic. | 3B.4; 3B.1 |
| Mixed, weak positive | [2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Turkey](https://www.ecoi.net/de/dokument/2128438.html) | U.S. Department of State via ecoi.net | 2024 | https://www.ecoi.net/de/dokument/2128438.html | The report says the law provided a right to challenge arrest/detention in court and required prompt judicial review, and that these rights were generally respected. But it also says numerous credible reports showed the government did not always observe those protections. | 3B.4; 3B.1 |

**Search gap**

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Erdoğan created or strengthened a meaningful new civilian-oversight or independent-abuse-investigation system for police, military, intelligence, prisons, or politically protected actors. The available material points the other way: formal complaint channels existed on paper, but they were weak, delayed, or ignored.
